text:
Tech shares rally on first trading day of 2018 led by chips, software 11:34 A.M. ET Published: Jan 2, 2018 2:08 p.m. ET Share Wallace Witkowski Reporter 
Tech shares rallied on the first day of trading in 2018 Tuesday with shares of chipmakers and software publishers leading the charge. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +1.32% rose 1.3%, outpacing the 0.6% gain on the S&P 500 Index SPX, +0.69% and the 0.2% rise in the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.30% The PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX, +2.40% rallied 2.1%, led by a 6.4% jump in shares of Advanced Micro Devices Inc. AMD, +6.32% and a 4.8% surge in Micron Technology Inc. MU, +5.42% shares. Other chipmakers with notable gains were Nvidia Corp. NVDA, +2.42% up 2.1%, Broadcom Ltd. AVGO, +4.04% up 3.3%, and Teradyne Inc. TER, +5.62% up 5.1%. Notable software gains included Electronic Arts Inc. EA, +4.18% up 4%, Symantec Corp. SYMC, +2.66% up 2.7%, and Salesforce.com Inc. CRM, +1.70% up 2.2%. Other big tech movers included Netflix Inc. NFLX, +4.85% up 5%, and Alibaba Group Holding Inc. BABA, +6.11% up 5.8%, while shares of Facebook Inc. FB, +2.45% rose 2.7%, and shares of Alphabet Inc. GOOG, +1.67% GOOGL, +1.89% and Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.50% were up nearly 2%. Quote References
